quests.passage: [Vent Flow 1-1] Hydrothermal vents release superheated mineral compounds, rich in hydrogen ____, into the pitch-black ocean depth.
quests.hint: Recall the chemical compounds that are typical of deep hot water volcanic vents. (Diving calibration index 1-1)
quests.explanation: Vents emit high amounts of toxic hydrogen sulfide, which forms the chemical basis of life. [Verified by Semantic Injection Unit 1].

quests.passage: [Microbe Dark 1-2] In complete darkness, deep bacteria perform ____ to synthesize organic nutrients from chemical energy.

quests.explanation: Since sunlight is absent, deep-sea bacteria must use chemosynthesis to convert sulfide into food. [Verified by Semantic Injection Unit 1].

quests.passage: [Forest Base 1-3] Giant kelp forests anchor themselves firmly to the rocky seabed using root-like structural ____.

quests.explanation: Holdfasts are the specialized anchoring structures kelp uses to cling to underwater rocks. [Verified by Semantic Injection Unit 1].
